verdict.rationale: Rollbar's access-token docs show project/account tokens can be restricted to narrow scopes (e.g. post_client_item-only tokens) and are now encrypted, which supports issuing least-privilege credentials that an MCP-connected agent could use, but there's no dedicated 'agent credential' workflow and a community report notes that default project tokens have standing read access that is not opt-in and never expires, undercutting a clean least-privilege story. missing for 10: agent-specific credential provisioning docs, confirmation that default tokens are scoped-by-default rather than broad, independent verification that scoped tokens work end-to-end with the MCP server/Resolve agent.
